notes: Pyrrhus was a Berean who accompanied Paul on his journey to Asia.

name: Quartus
meaning: A Christian brother in Corinth who sent greetings to Rome
notes: Quartus, a Christian brother in Corinth, sent greetings to the believers in Rome through Paul's letter.

name: Queen_of_Sheba
meaning: A queen who visited Solomon and praised his wisdom
notes: The Queen of Sheba visited King Solomon, tested him with questions, and praised his wisdom and prosperity.

name: Quirinius
meaning: Governor of Syria during a census mentioned in Luke
notes: Quirinius was the governor of Syria when a census was taken, as mentioned in Luke's Gospel.

name: Raamah
meaning: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham, great-grandson of Noah
notes: Raamah was a son of Cush, grandson of Ham, and great-grandson of Noah, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Rab-mag
meaning: A Babylonian official present at the fall of Jerusalem
notes: Rab-mag, a Babylonian official, was present at the capture of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar's army.

name: Rab-saris
meaning: A Babylonian official sent by King Sennacherib to Jerusalem
notes: Rab-saris was one of the Babylonian officials sent by King Sennacherib to Jerusalem during his campaign against Judah.

name: Rab-saris
meaning: A Babylonian official present at the fall of Jerusalem
notes: Rab-saris, a Babylonian official, was present at the capture of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar's army.

name: Rabshakeh
meaning: A Babylonian official who taunted Hezekiah and Jerusalem's people
notes: Rabshakeh was a Babylonian official who tried to intimidate Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem into surrendering.

name: Rachel
meaning: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin
notes: Rachel was the beloved wife of Jacob, and the mother of Joseph and Benjamin.

name: Raddai
meaning: One of David's brothers, son of Jesse
notes: Raddai was one of David's brothers, a son of Jesse.

name: Rahab
meaning: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho
notes: Rahab, a Canaanite woman from Jericho, hid the Israelite spies and was spared during the city's destruction.

name: Raham
meaning: Son of Shema and founder of Jorkeam, of Judah
notes: Raham was the son of Shema and the father or founder of Jorkeam, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Rakem
meaning: Son of Sheresh, of the tribe of Manasseh
notes: Rakem was a son of Sheresh, from the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Ram
meaning: Firstborn son of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah
notes: Ram was the firstborn son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Ram
meaning: Ancestor of Elihu, who spoke to Job
notes: Ram was an ancestor of Elihu, one of the men who spoke to Job.

name: Ram
meaning: Son of Hezron, ancestor of David and Jesus
notes: Ram was the son of Hezron and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Ramathites
meaning: People from Ramah who tended King David's vineyards
notes: The Ramathites were people from Ramah who were in charge of King David's vineyards.

name: Ramiah
meaning: One of the men who married foreign women
notes: Ramiah was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

name: Rapha
meaning: Ancestor of Philistine giants; his descendants fought against David's warriors.
notes: Rapha was the ancestor of several Philistine giants who fought against David and his mighty warriors.

name: Raphah
meaning: Son of Binea, a descendant of King Saul
notes: Raphah (or Rephaiah) was a son of Binea and a descendant of King Saul.

name: Raphu
meaning: Father of Palti, a spy sent by Moses
notes: Raphu was the father of Palti, one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

name: Reaiah
meaning: A Reubenite, son of Micah
notes: Reaiah was a Reubenite, the son of Micah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Reuben.

name: Reaiah
meaning: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile
notes: Reaiah was an ancestor of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

name: Reba
meaning: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites
notes: Reba was one of the five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

name: Rebekah
meaning: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau
notes: Rebekah was the wife of Isaac and the mother of Jacob and Esau.
